name: repo-unbox
title_zh: 代码库拆开讲成人话，零基础也能跟着点着学
tagline_zh: 英文注释看不懂、架构图绕晕？把整个仓库变成一页交互课，点哪讲哪，边点边学 vibe coding，不碰英文也能懂。
tagline_en: Stuck on English comments & tangled architecture? Turns any repo into one interactive Chinese page—click, see.
desc_en: 开箱任意代码库，生成中文交互课程——讲给零编程基础、正在学 vibe coding 的中文学员听。Turn any codebase into a beautiful, interactive single-page HTML course in Chinese, for non-technical learners whose first barrier is English. 触发词：开箱这个项目、把这个项目做成课程、讲讲这个代码库、这份代码是怎么跑的、生成课程、代码库导览；also 'turn this into a course', 'explain this codebase interactively', 'teach this code', 'interactive tutorial from code', 'codebase walkthrough', 'make a co
why_zh: 不是翻译文档，而是按代码真实调用链重排成课，每步可点击验证，让非技术学员从「看代码」变成「玩代码」。
why_en: Not a doc translator—it re-orders code along real call chains into clickable steps, turning passive reading into hands-on.
limit_zh: 只生成单页 HTML 课程，不产出可运行代码或部署环境；依赖本地 git 与网络拉取仓库。
limit_en: Outputs one HTML page only—no runnable code or setup. Needs local git & internet. Repos >50k lines or binary-heavy slow down or get truncated.
title_en: Turn any codebase into a clickable Chinese course
